Public mapping of account balances; written directly in transferFrom and list.

Wrapped ETH address used for pair derivation in the constructor.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance keys and transfer authorization.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used as the addLiquidityETH deadline (block.timestamp + 600).
Arbitrary delegatecall to an attacker-influenced address with attacker-supplied calldata, gated only by the owner check.

Lexicographically larger token address used in the pair hash.

Constructor argument that becomes the botProtection address.

edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the _from argument of the internal transferFrom call inside transfer.
msg.sender determines whether the allowance branch executes and is the spender key in allowance[_from][msg.sender].
msg.sender is the owner key written into allowance[msg.sender][_spender] in approve.
require(msg.sender == owner) is the sole authorization gate before the arbitrary delegatecall.
require(msg.sender == owner) authorizes the state overwrite and liquidity operation in list.
owner and allowance[msg.sender][uniPair] are derived from msg.sender in the constructor.
block.timestamp + 600 is computed inside list as the router deadline, making execution miner-timestamp dependent.
The timestamp-derived deadline is passed directly into the external addLiquidityETH call.
transfer unconditionally returns transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
checkBots modifier wraps the body of transferFrom before the state mutations run.
The modifier body immediately executes the low-level call to botProtection.
botProtection is the call target of the low-level call and can be a malicious or upgradeable contract.
uniPair is encoded into the calldata passed to the bot-protection call.
delegate executes the arbitrary delegatecall after the owner check.
User-supplied address a is the target of the delegatecall, letting the owner execute arbitrary logic in this context.
User-supplied bytes b is the raw calldata executed via delegatecall.
list invokes uniRouter.addLiquidityETH with value msg.value before distributing tokens.
uniRouter is the external contract on which addLiquidityETH is invoked.
Control returns from the external router call into list before the distribution loop executes.
totalSupply drives the caller balance computation totalSupply * 6 / 100 in list.
totalSupply is the operand of the unchecked multiplication.
list performs unchecked totalSupply * 6 / 100 arithmetic on attacker-reachable path.
transferFrom performs an unchecked subtraction on the allowance mapping.
transferFrom performs an unchecked addition on the recipient balance mapping.
balanceOf is read for the require and mutated for both sender and recipient in transferFrom.
allowance is read, decremented and validated inside transferFrom.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
pairFor returns the computed address assigned to uniPair.
The constructor calls pairFor(wETH, address(this)) to derive the pair.
The constructor assigns the pairFor result into uniPair.
The constructor grants infinite allowances to the router and to msg.sender on the pair.
wETH is used as a token argument in the constructor's pairFor call.
Constructor parameter _botProtection is consumed by the constructor.
Constructor parameter _botProtection is written into the botProtection state variable.
Parameter _to is the recipient forwarded by transfer.
Parameter _value is the amount forwarded by transfer.
Parameter _from indexes balanceOf and allowance inside transferFrom.
Parameter _to is credited in balanceOf inside transferFrom.
Parameter _value is subtracted from the sender and added to the recipient in transferFrom.
_from is encoded into the bot-protection call arguments.
_to is encoded into the bot-protection call arguments.
_value is encoded into the bot-protection call arguments.
_numList sets balanceOf[address(this)] and the liquidity token amount.
_tos is iterated in the distribution loop of list.
_amounts values are written directly into balanceOf in the distribution loop.
token0 is hashed into the pair address computation.
token1 is hashed into the pair address computation.
notABot is the success flag enforced by require inside the checkBots modifier.
isNotBot holds the unused returndata of the bot-protection call.
